name: swarm-board-terminal-motion
principles: Motion must never resize a panel, move a row, or change column widths.
Running state uses low-frequency status refresh, not decorative animation.
Attention escalation may pulse color or badge text, but preserves readable labels.
Reduced motion disables spinner frame changes and all pulse effects.

worker_status_change.rule: replace badge and current action in place

attention_item_added.rule: insert Attention panel below Worker Board without modal overlay

result_preview_update.rule: replace summary fields in stable order

finished_result.rule: swap surface to ProductResultCard; retain prompt line

rules: Use static [RUN] badge instead of spinner.
Do not blink or pulse attention badges.
Refresh elapsed age at normal 1s cadence.
